description: Bitcoin mining economics: Hashprice in USD and sats per TH/s per day, revenue split (subsidy vs fees) over the last 144 blocks, network hashrate and difficulty, and BTC price. Formula: dailyBlocksPerTh = (1e12 * 86400) / (diff * 2^32); hashprice = dailyBlocksPerTh * (totalRewardSat / 144). Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
